create_easyocr_model: create an EasyOcrModel instance with enabled flag, artifacts path, options, and accelerator options
download_ocr_models: download EasyOCR detection and recognition models to a local directory with optional progress display
run_ocr_on_pages: run OCR on a batch of pages to extract text cells with bounding boxes and confidence scores
get_options_type: get the EasyOcrOptions type class for pipeline configuration validation
test_easyocr_integration: test EasyOCR integration with GPU detection, MPS warning suppression, and confidence threshold filtering
